commands.name: init
commands.purpose: Create starter objective and policy files.

commands.name: go
commands.syntax: donestate go "GOAL" [--repo PATH] [--accept TEXT] [--publish none|branch|pull_request] [--base REF] [--verification-requirements FILE] [--trusted-verifiers HEX[,HEX...]] [--state-dir PATH]
commands.purpose: Execute the prose-first local workflow, optionally publish a branch or pull request, and seal the result for independent verification.

commands.name: create
commands.purpose: Durably create an objective without starting execution.

commands.name: start
commands.purpose: Start a previously created RECEIVED objective.

commands.name: run
commands.purpose: Create and immediately execute an explicit objective under an explicit policy.

commands.name: resume
commands.purpose: Resume a recoverable local run from durable state.

commands.name: cancel
commands.purpose: Cancel eligible local work without rewriting settled or ambiguous history.

commands.name: delete
commands.purpose: Delete a settled or cancelled local run and its durable local records.

commands.name: list
commands.purpose: List durable local runs as structured JSON.

commands.name: status
commands.purpose: Inspect one run, its actions, and event-chain validity.

commands.name: handoff
commands.purpose: Create the exact verification handoff; emits v2 for sealed published subjects and v1 for historical/local-only runs.

commands.name: verify-response
commands.purpose: Validate and record a complete v2 independent-verifier response.

commands.name: verify-opstruth
commands.purpose: Request independent OpsTruth verification of a sealed local published subject and record the returned v2 response.

commands.name: attest
commands.purpose: Record a signed legacy v1 independent-verifier attestation.

commands.name: verify-log
commands.purpose: Verify the tamper-evident event chain and fail non-zero if invalid.

commands.name: maintenance-discover
commands.purpose: Discover explicitly labelled repair issues plus failing workflow evidence using locally authenticated GitHub CLI access.

commands.name: maintenance-list
commands.purpose: List locally recorded bounded maintenance findings.

commands.name: maintenance-repair
commands.syntax: donestate maintenance-repair FINDING_ID [--repo PATH] [--base REF] [--verification-requirements FILE] [--trusted-verifiers HEX[,HEX...]] [--state-dir PATH]
commands.purpose: Run one eligible labelled-issue repair and publish it as a PR-only change.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.purpose: Return machine-readable CLI capability discovery for humans and agents.

commands.name: demo
commands.purpose: Run a bounded local demonstration that intentionally stops at AWAITING_VERIFICATION.
